item.title: OWWA to add 10,000 scholarship slots as trust fund hits record $368M
item.description: The Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) will open 10,000 additional scholarship slots this year for children of overseas Filipino workers (OFWs), following a record-high trust fund of $368 million for 2026.
